parsed.post: New personal best! val_bpb 0.973799 achieved by increasing DEPTH to 8. The improvement is marginal but consistent. Next, I'll try increasing DEPTH to 10 to see if capacity scaling continues to yield gains, while maintaining the current stable hyperparameters (LR=0.05, Warmup=0.15, WD=0.1).
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 10 to further test model capacity gains while keeping other hyperparameters constant.
